message.content: {"items":[{"title":"German Family Planning Survey 1971","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.10804","justification":"National survey on family planning and contraception in the Federal Republic of Germany in 1971, includes questions on fertility regulation, contraceptive use, and attitudes toward reproduction, directly addressing reproductive health in Germany in the early 1970s."},{"title":"Population Policy and Family Planning 1974","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.10806","justification":"Study on attitudes toward population policy and family planning in West Germany in 1974, covering contraception, desired number of children, and related reproductive health topics during the mid‑1970s."},{"title":"Birth Control and Family Planning 1974 (Allensbach Survey 6036)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1082","justification":"Allensbach survey focusing on birth control knowledge, use of contraceptives, and family planning attitudes in the Federal Republic of Germany around 1974, directly relevant to reproductive health behavior in the 1970s."},{"title":"Family and Fertility Survey 1976 (FRG)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0809","justification":"Survey on family formation, fertility behavior, and contraceptive use in West Germany in 1976, providing empirical data on reproductive health and fertility decisions in the second half of the 1970s."},{"title":"Family Planning and Contraception 1972 (FRG)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0820","justification":"Dataset examining knowledge, attitudes, and use of contraception in the Federal Republic of Germany in 1972, directly concerned with reproductive health and fertility control."},{"title":"Survey on Abortion, Family Planning, and Sexual Behaviour 1971 (FRG)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0810","justification":"Includes questions on abortion, contraceptive practice, and sexual behaviour among adults in West Germany in 1971, highly relevant for reproductive health norms and practices in the early 1970s."},{"title":"Attitudes toward Abortion and Family Planning 1975 (FRG)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0973","justification":"Focused on public opinion on abortion legislation and family planning in the Federal Republic of Germany in 1975, providing attitudinal context for reproductive health policy debates mid‑decade."},{"title":"Contraception and Sexuality of Youth 1978 (FRG)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1185","justification":"Study of adolescents and young adults in West Germany in 1978, covering contraceptive use, sexual behaviour, and knowledge of reproductive health, giving insight into late‑1970s reproductive health among youth."},{"title":"Women’s Health and Family Planning 1977 (FRG)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1042","justification":"Survey of women’s health topics including gynecological care, pregnancy, contraception, and family planning in West Germany in 1977, explicitly centered on reproductive health issues."},{"title":"Family, Fertility and Contraception 1970 (FRG)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0695","justification":"Early‑1970 baseline survey in West Germany on family size ideals, contraceptive use, and fertility behavior, relevant for reproductive health patterns at the beginning of the 1970s in Germany."}]}
